title: Playboy May 2008 Olga Kurbatova Chris Farley Bob Saget Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers clean and bright with light handling wear; spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, May 2008. Original $5.99 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Cover: Olga Kurbatova.

Cover features: The new babes of Russia; Chris Farley's last days - the untold story (exclusive excerpt); Fareed Zakaria interview; Bob Saget 20Q; card pro Jennifer Leigh plays strip poker; spring baseball preview.

Back cover: Wittnauer watch ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
